name: God
text: He is the Rock, His work is perfect; all His ways are just. A God of faithfulness without injustice, righteous and upright is He.

name: Jesus
text: And being found in appearance as a man, He humbled Himself and became obedient to death-even death on a cross.

name: the Holy Spirit
text: The wind blows where it wishes. You hear its sound, but you do not know where it comes from or where it is going. So it is with everyone born of the Spirit.”

name: the Father
text: To the one who overcomes, I will grant the right to sit with Me on My throne, just as I overcame and sat down with My Father on His throne.
